anchor.label: thm:witnesses
anchor.statement: \label{thm:witnesses}\lean{Shape.witnesses} For every $j$ there is a function $x$ with $x(j) = j$ and $j \le x(j)$, and there is a boolean $x$ that is true.

links.doc:
Two witnesses of the same name in sibling parts, each of its own type, and one witness
shared by the two parts of its body.

exact.text:
∀ (toProfile : Shape.Profile) (N : Nat) (support : ∀ (n : Nat), N ≤ n → toProfile.f n = 0) (p : Nat)
  (periodic : ∀ (n : Nat), n + p < N → toProfile.f (n + p) = toProfile.f n) (toProfile_1 : Shape.Profile) (N_1 : Nat)
  (support_1 : ∀ (n : Nat), N_1 ≤ n → toProfile_1.f n = 0) (p_1 : Nat)
  (periodic_1 : ∀ (n : Nat), n + p_1 < N_1 → toProfile_1.f (n + p_1) = toProfile_1.f n),
  ({ toProfile := toProfile, N := N, support := support, p := p, periodic := periodic } =
      { toProfile := toProfile_1, N := N_1, support := support_1, p := p_1, periodic := periodic_1 }) =
    (toProfile = toProfile_1 ∧ N = N_1 ∧ p = p_1)
